description.zh-CN: 测试粘贴图片、选择图片和添加文件后的输入与消息状态。
description.en: Test pasted images, selected images, and file attachments in the composer and messages.

description.zh-CN: 粘贴图片或添加文件后发送，整个过程不会上传或调用模型。
description.en: Paste an image or add a file and send it without uploading or calling a model.

assistant.zh-CN: 我看到了这张图片。这里是离线模拟回复，用来检查图片缩略图、预览和流式消息的表现。
assistant.en: I can see the image. This offline response checks the thumbnail, preview, and streaming message states.

assistant.zh-CN: 我收到了这个文件。这里是离线模拟回复，用来检查附件卡片、文件名过长和发送状态。
assistant.en: I received the file. This offline response checks the attachment card, long filenames, and delivery states.
